Crewboard documentation

Crewboard is a task board for small crews. This site documents how to run and configure it. The product itself lives in apps/web.

Getting started

  1. Install dependencies with pnpm install.
  2. Start the app with pnpm dev.
  3. Open the board and add your first task.

Concepts

Tasks move through three columns: To do, In progress, and Done. Assignees are optional.
